description.narrative: The goal of this project is to identify the needs of local self-governments (LSGs) for enhancing public service delivery through innovative solutions from innovative entities -small and medium enterprises (SMEs) and research institutes - that are eligible for the Innovation Funds financing program. The overarching objective is to create a sustainable innovative financing (Gov-Tech) mechanism that aligns municipal needs with technology-driven solutions, while creating new opportunities for deploying and financing innovative entities’ solutions. To achieve this, the project will (1) assess LSG requirements through consultations with key stakeholders, (2) identify and refine priority challenges suitable for innovative financing, and (3) design and institutionalize the Gov-Tech Mechanism. The result will be a sustainable platform that accelerates improvements of local services, mobilizes private-sector innovation, and fosters enduring partnerships for inclusive, technology-driven development that contributes to the achievement of Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) in Serbia.
